title: Mass in C
content: Here's a portrait in watercolor drawn entirely during a thrilling performance of Beethoven's Mass in C at Bard College.Jeanette was singing in the alto section.I used twowatercolor pencils(reddish brown and black) andthreewater brushes(clear water, black ink, and blue ink)in a 5x8 inchwatercolor notebook. I chose these tools carefully before the concert started. Since there was no intermission, I knew I couldn't fish around in the sketch bag, and I had to hold the unused tools very quietly in my left hand.Conductor James Bagwell delivered the tempi at a fast clip, so the running length was about 50 minutes.
